title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Overview:
Zenith Advisory Partners are working with a reputable and established business in Carlisle that are seeking an organised, accurate and proactive Payroll Assistant to join a busy payroll team within a leading business.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with payroll experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to develop their career within payroll. You will play a key role in ensuring their employees are paid accurately and on time, supporting payroll processing across a diverse workforce.
Key Responsibilities:
- Process, manage and maintain both the monthly payroll and Time and Attendance software accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Maintain accurate employee payroll records, including starters, leavers and amendments.
- Process overtime, allowances, deductions, and other payroll adjustments.
- Manage payroll queries from employees and managers, providing professional and timely responses.
- Complete statutory payroll requirements, including PAYE, National Insurance, pensions and statutory payments.
- Ensure all payroll changes are supported by appropriate authorisation.
- Reconcile payroll reports and investigate discrepancies.
- Liaise with HR, Finance and operational teams to resolve payroll issues.
- Support year-end processes, including P60s and other statutory reporting.
- Assist with payroll audits and continuous improvement initiatives.

Skills & Experience Required:
- Experienced in payroll administration, ideally within a high-volume payroll environment.
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail.
- Confident working with numbers and identifying discrepancies.
- Comfortable working to tight deadlines.
- Able to handle confidential and sensitive information appropriately.
- A strong communicator with excellent customer service skills.
- Competent using Microsoft Excel and payroll systems.
- Able to work independently while also being a strong team player.
- Keen to develop their knowledge and career within payroll.

What's on Offer:
- Salary up to £30,000, depending on experience.
- 33 days of annual leave (including bank holidays)
- Company pension - 5%
- Sick pay
- Additional leave
- Employee discount
- Health & wellbeing programme
- On-site parking
- Referral programme
